reason: My child starts school soon, and 25 thousand a month costs less than one tutor lesson. It goes through Click, the same as my Kinopoisk. I'll use the free 14 days, and if the weekly report shows new letters, I'll pay for one month and watch.
objection: Will my child actually learn, or just tap at a cartoon mascot? If the report only says 'played 10 minutes' and not what was really learned, I'll cancel.
would_change_my_mind: If after the trial my child still can't name the letters when I check myself, without the app, I won't pay.
